toolchain.cc_sh:
#!/bin/sh
# usage: cc.sh SRC.c OUT.o [extra flags]   Host compile with the shipping compiler (clang 9.0.3 r353983c, darwin build) and the
# Lenovo-lineage headers + stock-config autoconf.h under ktree/. Flags are the kernel's KBUILD_CFLAGS for this config (Makefile, arch/arm64/Makefile).
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
K=$H/ktree
src=$1; out=$2; shift 2
exec $H/tc-darwin/clang/bin/clang-9 --target=aarch64-linux-gnu -nostdinc -isystem $H/tc-darwin/clang/lib64/clang/9.0.3/include \
 -I$K/arch/arm64/include -I$K/arch/arm64/include/generated/uapi -I$K/arch/arm64/include/generated -I$K/include \
 -I$K/arch/arm64/include/uapi -I$K/include/uapi -I$K/include/linux -I$K/include/generated/uapi -include $K/include/linux/kconfig.h \
 -D__KERNEL__ -Qunused-arguments -Wall -Wundef -Wno-trigraphs -fno-strict-aliasing -fno-common -Werror-implicit-function-declaration \
 -Wno-format-security -std=gnu89 -fno-PIE -mno-implicit-float -DCONFIG_AS_LSE=1 -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables \
 -fno-pic -fno-delete-null-pointer-checks -O2 -fstack-protector-strong -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
 -fno-optimize-sibling-calls -g -mno-global-merge -Wno-unused-const-variable -Wno-gnu -Wno-address-of-packed-member -Wno-tautological-compare \
 -DKBUILD_BASENAME='"x"' -DKBUILD_MODNAME='"x"' "$@" -c "$src" -o "$out"
